content.text: Kafka Stream API allows you to:

rows: Read data from Kafka and apply transformations or logic
Discard unwanted messages based on custom conditions
Branch a stream into multiple substreams (e.g., using .branch(...))
Join two or more Kafka streams by key
Aggregate or analyze data over time intervals (e.g., every 1 minute)
A continuous flow of records from Kafka. Represented in Java using KStream.
A named channel in Kafka to which producers publish and from which consumers (or stream apps) read.
A Kafka abstraction for handling unbounded records (similar to logs).
A changelog stream; represents an up-to-date view (e.g., last value per key).
A functional interface used to filter records based on boolean conditions.
The main class to start and manage the stream processing application.
